svg.title: How ConstructBench works
svg.desc: A seed feeds a generator that writes each task and computes its answer; a model answers, with or without a code tool; every field is graded strictly; and results are reported with 95 percent Wilson intervals, per domain and per difficulty.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Answers are computed by the same code that wrote the task, so the reference is right by construction.

svg.text: No dependencies to generate and score. Runs are resumable and keep raw responses, so a grader fix re-scores without re-running.
